source: Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF), Department of Agricultural Extension, in collaboration with the Siem Reap Provincial Department of Agriculture and an economic development program, trifold brochure "វិធីដាំខ្នុរ" (How to Plant Jackfruit) / "បទពិសោធន៍ជោគជ័យ ក្នុងការដាំខ្នុរ របស់កសិករគំរូ" (Successful Experience in Growing Jackfruit of a Model Farmer), Siem Reap, 2013
text:
Jackfruit seedlings should be prepared/hardened off for about 1 week before planting, and should be watered 2 days before planting.

Before placing the seedling, sprinkle lime powder and about 2 tablespoons of FURADAN pesticide granules into the prepared pit to protect the young plant from soil pests.

Before planting, remove the seedling from its nursery bag, taking care to peel the bag open carefully so the soil around the roots (the root ball) does not break apart.

Place the seedling in the pit and bury the root ball in soil, keeping the graft union above the surrounding ground level by roughly the width of a hand or finger.

Firm the soil around the base of the seedling by pressing it down, then stake the young tree by tying it to a supporting stick.
